<function name="GetArrivalSequence" parent="NPC" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the sequence to be played when the NPC arrives at its goal.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">Sequence ID to be played, or -1 if there's no sequence.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
